_description: CCNL lavoro domestico, convivente a orario ridotto level B (Tabella B), March 2026 regular run, permanent, 30 weekly hours.
_notes: Tabella B, lavoratori conviventi art. 14 c. 2, valori mensili decorrenti dal 01/01/2026, livello B: 702,25.
Board and lodging are provided in kind (art. 36; Tabella F, x 30 = 199,80): not paid in cash on a regular run, so no fixed allowance is paid.
Hours: 30 weekly hours, the most art. 14 c. 2 allows the convivente a orario ridotto, 120 contributable hours (30 x 4 weeks).
